answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Every entry must show Millbound flower seller orchard warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant flower sellers show after flower market trials. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody is waved through free: an examination charge of $33, charged again each time a name fails is the price, and the whisper never covers it twice. The nectar is on the docket.
